causes.label: demand
causes.quote: On 19 January maximum temperatures in Melbourne and Adelaide exceeded 40°C, leading to high forecast demand for electricity.

causes.label: wind_output
causes.quote: Local generator availability was lower than forecast for the 2.30 pm and 3 pm trading intervals by around 220 MW and around 70 MW for the 5 pm trading interval. This was mainly due to lower than forecast semi-scheduled wind generation.

causes.label: administered_pricing_or_intervention
causes.quote: Due to the ever tightening supply and demand balance in both regions, at around 2 pm, AEMO activated Reliability Emergency Reserve Trader (RERT) contracts in Victoria and South Australia. As a result, AEMO invoked special pricing arrangements called 'what-if' pricing.
